Fire Myrmidons are a type of Elemental creature that can be transformed into via  Combat Wild Shape, or summoned with the spell  Conjure Elemental.

About Fire Myrmidons

Fire Myrmidons are created by conjuring and bonding elemental fire into ritually created armour.

Notes

  • Fire Myrmidon creatures have a base initiative of 4 instead of the usual 0. With a Dexterity modifier of 4, this gives +8 initiative total. This extra initiative does not apply to wild shape form.
